title: Climb
description:
The third animation in the Woojoo series.
This film uses rock climbing as a metaphor for the way we face and solve problems in our own lives. To me, a "climbing project" is just like a chapter of life: you study the route, you prep your hands, and you give it everything you have.
But we all eventually "bump into a wall"—a specific move or a moment where our strength fails, no matter how many times we try. This story is about that repetitive cycle of falling and starting over until your fingers are tired and your spirit is worn down. It’s in that exact moment of frustration that we realize we don't have to solve everything alone. Sometimes, the only way to "send" the project and reach the top is to set aside our pride and ask the people around us for help.
